scientific_integrity: Exhaustiveness is symbolic: deficiency eliminates prime powers, abundance leaves a finite \(p^2q\) list, and a complete complementary-pair subset analysis excludes squarefree \(pqr\). The finite program is only a regression check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the range \(\Omega(n)\le3\). It does not classify strongly pseudoperfect integers at or above the sharp threshold \(\Omega(n)=4\).
title: Strongly pseudoperfect integers with \(\Omega(n)\le3\)
